Alex H: FYI customer sent a security questionnaire asking for: RBAC matrix, KMS rotation proof, sample audit-log exports (SIEM mapping), and service-account lifecycle. Who can own collating artifacts?
Jamie L: I can own RBAC matrix + CSV generation. have a template from previous enterprise asks.
Meera S: I'll take KMS rotation docs and HSM / envelope-key notes. need to confirm whether they want rotation proof for Hosted or Private tenants.
Alex H: good call — customer said both. Hosted account for pilot, then Private for prod. they want explicit proof for hosted CMEK rotations and for onprem HSM policies.
Jamie L: For audit logs, we can provide a time-bounded ELK export. sample query (for ops):
```
index=audit_logs AND event_type:key_rotate AND tenant_id:acme-corp
| sort timestamp desc | limit 100
```
Jamie L: That query returns the canonical fields we map to customer SIEM: timestamp, actor_id, actor_role, key_id, rotation_event_id, before/after_key_version.
Priya R: Service-account lifecycle is handled by short-lived IAM credentials + rotation via our internal STS. example (AWS-style):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service --role-session-name acme-session
```
Priya R: For Private deployments we hand off KMS control (customer-managed envelope keys); annotated note: "customer holds root KEK; Redwood rotates DEKs and records rotation events into audit stream."
Meera S: For Hosted CMEK we rotate the data-encryption-keys every 90 days; encryption key metadata and rotation logs are signed and exported on request. I'll attach the signed manifest and rotation timestamps.
Matt P: Customer also asked about SLA for evidence delivery and a timeline for remediation of any findings. propose we commit to 5 business days for a complete evidence bundle, 72h for triage confirmation. thoughts?
Alex H: 5bd sounds ok for a first bundle. 72h for triage ack is reasonable. include a line that legal/NDAs may be required before full raw logs are shared.
Jamie L: uploading RBAC CSV to secure share now: https://secure-files.redwood.example/acme/rbac-matrix.csv (will remove later). please review. :thumbsup:
Meera S: I'm pulling signed rotation manifests and HSM policy excerpts; one question — do we include redacted operator IDs or full IDs? customer asked for operator identity provenance.
Alex H: they want provenance but limited PII. provide operator IDs (opaque service-account IDs) + role mapping, not personal emails. note that in reply.
Priya R: also recommend attaching a short runbook snippet showing how we produce the audit export (commands + retention window) so they can reproduce.
Jamie L: added runbook snippet to the share.
Alex H: thanks. I'll draft the questionnaire responses and link artifacts. please drop final attachments in the share by EOD so I can send tomorrow morning to their security team.
Meera S: will do.
Matt P: I'll coordinate SLA language with legal and loop them into the thread.
 evidence-bot: created evidence-workflow #4287 for "acme pilot evidence bundle" — assigned Alex H, Meera S, Jamie L. deadline 2024-12-06.
Alex H: perfect — marking ownership. ping if anything blocks. :pray:
